-- Value Range
-- - This module generates a list of values given a min value, max value, and
--   number of elements in the list.
-- - Used to populate the weapon skill rank table tooltip given two values.

local p = {}

-- Helper function to convert the string to a number. Removes all plus and percent
-- characters. i.e. "67%" becomes 67.
local function parse_value(str)
	if (not str) then
		return nil
	end
	str = mw.text.trim(str)
	str = str:gsub("%%", "")
    str = str:gsub("%+", "")
    return tonumber(str)
end

-- Helper function to convert the number to a string. Removes all trailing zeroes
-- and if there are no decimals, removes the decimal point.
local function format_value(num)
	return tostring(num)
		:gsub("(%..-)0+$", "%1") -- Remove trailing zeros
		:gsub("%.$", "")		 -- Remove decimal point if any
end

-- Helper function that creates a struct {plus, percent} that records whether
-- the string originally contained such characters. Used to return the characters
-- when constructing the new list.
local function get_format(str)
	if (not str) then
		return {plus = false, percent = false}
	end
	str = mw.text.trim(str)

	return {plus = str:sub(1,1) == "+", percent = str:sub(-1) == "%"}
end

-- Returns a range of values given a min, max, and number of steps.
local function _get_list(args)
	local min_str = args[1]
	local max_str = args[2]
	
	local min = parse_value(min_str)
	local max = parse_value(max_str)
	local steps = tonumber(args[3]) or 9

    if ((not min) or (not max)) then
        return ""
    end

    local step_size = (max - min) / steps
    local results = {}
    
    -- Check formatting of min_str and max_str and use same formatting.
    local min_format = get_format(min_str)
	local max_format = get_format(max_str)

	local is_use_plus = min_format.plus or max_format.plus
	local is_use_percent = min_format.percent or max_format.percent
	
	local prefix = is_use_plus and "+" or ""
	local suffix = is_use_percent and "%" or ""
    
    for i = 0, steps do
    	local value = min + step_size * i
        results[#results + 1] = string.format("%s%s%s", prefix, format_value(value), suffix)
    end
    
    local output = table.concat(results, ",")
    mw.log(output)
    return output
end

function p.get_list(frame)
    local args = frame:getParent().args
    return _get_list(args)
end

return p
